default.q.test-9-q8-8.verdict:
✅ Correct answer: (c) 泳ぎ
Before the particle は and the ability/strength adjective 得意 (good at, strong in), a noun is needed. When the verb 泳ぐ is converted to its stem form, it becomes the noun 泳ぎ, referring to swimming as a skill or activity.
default.q.test-9-q8-8.explanation: Many Japanese verbs can be turned into nouns expressing a skill, action, or method by putting them into the ます-form and removing ます, as in 泳ぎ, 走り, and 歌. The pattern `[Noun] + は得意/苦手です` is commonly used to express someone’s strength or weakness in a particular skill. Thus, 「海の近くで育ったので、泳ぎは得意です。」means: “Because I grew up near the sea, I am good at swimming.” For comparison: 「昔から歌が得意で、よくカラオケに行きます。」(I have always been good at singing, so I often go to karaoke.) If you want to use the dictionary-form verb 泳ぐ, you must nominalize it as `泳ぐこと/泳ぐのは得意です`; you cannot attach は directly to form `泳ぐは`.
default.q.test-9-q8-8.why.0: ✗ (a) 泳ぐ is a verb in dictionary form and cannot directly precede the particle は; it must first be nominalized as 泳ぐこと or 泳ぐの.
default.q.test-9-q8-8.why.1: ✗ (b) 泳いで is the te-form, used to connect clauses or accompany an auxiliary verb; it cannot function as the subject/topic before は.
default.q.test-9-q8-8.why.2: ✓ (c) 泳ぎ is a derived noun formed from the ます-stem of 泳ぐ, expressing swimming ability and combining correctly with the structure ～は得意です.
default.q.test-9-q8-8.why.3: ✗ (d) 泳いだ is the past form (た-form) of a verb and cannot directly precede the particle は to express a general ability or specialty.
default.q.test-9-q9-9.verdict:
✅ Correct answer: (a) 人によって
The grammar「N ＋ によって」indicates variation or differences depending on the subject, fitting perfectly with the predicate「違う」that follows.
default.q.test-9-q9-9.explanation: The noun +「〜によって」means "depending on N" or "according to N." It expresses variation or differences according to the object or circumstances and often appears with words such as 違う or 様々. The complete sentence means: "Everyone has different tastes, so it is very difficult to recommend a suitable restaurant." A similar example is: 「国によって生活習慣やマナーが違います。」(Daily customs and manners differ depending on the country.) To avoid confusion in the test, remember:「〜によって」indicates differentiation according to each object (depending on...),「〜にとって」emphasizes a standpoint of evaluation (for...), and「〜によれば」introduces a source of information (according to...).
default.q.test-9-q9-9.why.0: ✓ (a) It expresses the meaning “depending on the person” and combines naturally with the predicate 「違う」 (to differ), indicating differences among people.
default.q.test-9-q9-9.why.1: ✗ (b) 「〜によれば」introduces a source of information (“according to...”); it usually combines with a reporting ending such as 「〜そうだ」, not with 「違う」.
default.q.test-9-q9-9.why.2: ✗ (c) The pattern 「〜にとって」 expresses a standpoint or evaluative perspective (“for…”), and is not used to indicate differences from person to person.
default.q.test-9-q9-9.why.3: ✗ (d) The pattern 「〜につれて」 expresses a proportional change over time (“the more..., the more...”); it does not fit the context of this sentence.
